title: Semantic Signal-Assisted Inspection and Recovery Allocation in Reverse Logistics
abstract: arXiv:2609.02116v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reverse-logistics operators often decide how to inspect and route returned assets before their condition is fully observed, while full inspection consumes scarce labor. Semantic Signal-Assisted Decision Support converts return notes into a condition factor and a signal-quality score that guide inspection depth and recovery allocation under shared labor capacity. We evaluate the framework in three synthetic benchmark scenarios spanning information technology decommissioning, aircraft maintenance, and consumer-electronics returns. Across 30 paired simulation seeds, the keyword implementation improves net recovery value relative to a structured-feature comparator with noisy full inspection while reducing inspection cost in all three scenarios. A risk-blind comparator that skips inspection altogether still records higher value under the benchmark's purely economic objective. translated_title: 逆向物流中的语义信号辅助检验与回收分配
translated_abstract: 逆向物流运营商通常需要在退货资产的真实状况被完全观测之前，决定如何对其进行检验和路由，而全面检验会消耗稀缺的劳动力资源。语义信号辅助决策支持框架将退货备注转化为状况因子和信号质量评分，在共享劳动力产能的约束下指导检验深度和回收分配。我们在三个合成基准场景中评估了该框架，涵盖信息技术设备退役、飞机维护和消费电子产品退货。在30个配对仿真种子中，基于关键词的实现相对于采用带噪声全面检验的结构化特征比较方法，在所有三个场景中都提高了净回收价值并降低了检验成本。而完全跳过检验的风险盲视比较方法，在基准的纯经济目标下反而记录了更高的价值。在检验成本相同的情况下，评分引导的定向检验增加了5.39万（原文截断）……
tldr: 本文提出一种语义信号辅助决策支持框架，将退货备注转化为状况因子和信号质量评分，在共享劳动力产能约束下指导逆向物流的检验深度与回收分配，在多个仿真场景中相比结构化特征方法提高了净回收价值并降低了检验成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Semantic Signal-Assisted Decision Support framework that converts return notes into a condition factor and signal-quality score to guide inspection depth and recovery allocation in reverse logistics, improving net recovery value and reducing inspection costs compared to structured-feature baselines across multiple simulated scenarios.
